sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
 testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
 indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The 
 GTT relay and an associated type VAA auxiliary follower relay are designed to 
 prevent over fluxing of the 500MVA auto transformer 500/220/11kv.

The 
 over fluxing protection operates when the ratio of terminal voltage to 
 frequency exceeds a pre-determined setting, and resets when the ratio falls 
 below 95 to 98% of the operating ratio.
Safety Precautions

A work 
 permit must be issued and maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable safety category,

Safety rope with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required.
Safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety Helmet ...etc.
The transformer must be isolated, earthed from the three sides.

Switch 
 off the DC power supply before inserting or withdrawing the relay.

sections.text: Checking the Minimum Operating Voltage
Connect the variable AC source to points 9 & 10 ... see figure 1

Adjust 
 the voltage to the normal voltage.

Slowly 
 increase the voltage until the left auxiliary relay picks up after about 0.5 
 to 1 sec.

Record 
 this voltage value (Minimum operating voltage).

Calculate 
 the V/F ratio and compare it with the setting.

Slowly 
 lowering the applied voltage until the auxiliary relay resets.

Record 
 this voltage value (resetting voltage).

The 
 resetting voltage should be greater than 95% of the measured operating 
 voltage.

sections.text:
Checking the Time 
Delay

Connect 
 the output contact 3 & 4 ... see figure 1 to the timer contact of the test set.

Re-apply 
 the minimum operating voltage; the timer will stop once the right auxiliary 
 relay has picked up.

Record 
 this time and compare it with the time delay setting.

Remove 
 all the leads from the relay.

Insert 
 the relay in its case.

items:
Insert 
 the relay in its case.

sections.text:
Checking the Tripping of all Breakers Associated with the 
Relay

Close 
 all breakers associated with this relay.

Disconnect 
 the wires from points 9 & 10 from the relay.

Apply 
 the minimum operating voltage on 9&10 until the relay operates after the 
 time delay and check the breakers are tripped.

Re-connect 
 the wires to points 9 & 10 and reset the relay.

sections.text: Return the Relay and the Associated equipment to Service
Disconnect the Sverker 650 & all connection leads from the relay
Make sure that every disconnected wires are connected to their positions.
Check that the VT connections are in normal connections.
Reconnect any alarm or disturbance signal you have disconnected.
Check that there are no alarms on the relay panel or control panel.
Return relay to its normal place.
